utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Could the Registrar please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes, good morning, Your Honour. This is case number IT-04-83-PT, the Prosecutor versus Rasim Delic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Can I have the appearances?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour, for the Prosecution, Tecla Henry-Benjamin and Daryl Mundis, assisted by our case manager, Andres Vatter.

utterances.speaker: MS. WHITAKER
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour, I'm Quincy Whitaker, co-counsel, assisted by Geoff Roberts, legal assistant. May I apologise for Ms. Vidovic being unavailable today.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you, Ms. Whitaker. The Chamber is currently seized of the Prosecution motion submission on amended indictment pursuant to Trial Chamber's decision of 13th of December in 2005, and as well the second Defence motion alleging defects in the form of the indictment. However, the Trial Chamber, in the same decision, while granting the Prosecution's request to withdraw its proposed amended indictment of -- dated 31st of October last year, so that the Prosecution would be able to have an opportunity to assess the potential impact of the findings in the Hadzihasanovic and Kubura Trial Judgement ordered the Prosecution to submit a new proposed amended indictment within 30 days of the rendering of the Hadzihasanovic Judgement. Therefore, I'm speaking for myself, I'm of the opinion that it would be better for the Chamber to wait and see if the Prosecution is going to file its proposed amended indictment yet again and make determination on the -- any challenges to the indictment altogether. I wonder if it suits -- it will suit the parties as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President, Your Honour. That would seem to be a sensible course of action as far as the Prosecution is concerned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. I think that's the only issue before the Chamber, but I wonder if there is anything for the parties to raise.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Prosecution has nothing further to raise, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Then it will conclude our Status Conference. I wish you -- everybody, a very good day today.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at
